case_constraints_checked: No new infrastructure unless the bottleneck evidence justifies it
The recommendation must include verification steps
The report must preserve uncertainty and evidence against the chosen action

checks_run.description: Final report includes all required audit sections.
Every evidence item includes source_type, source_uri, claim, reliability_score, and relevance_score.
Hypotheses do not use novelty_score as a core MVP field.
Evidence against the selected action is explicitly listed before recommendation.
New Redis infrastructure is not recommended before bottleneck verification.

contradictions.description: Caching could help read-heavy traffic, but current evidence points to query shape as the safer first test.

mode_specific_checklist: Prefer reversible local test before infrastructure change
